🚀 Welcome to ¡Live Like a Toy!
A Roleplay game inspired by Toy Story. Explore iconic locations and meet your favorite characters! 🌟 Follow for news!
🩷The game is new and may have some bugs with each update, but I promise I’m always working hard to ensure the best experience and satisfaction while you play.

Latest Updates:
•  Al’s Apartment (with a secret!)
•  Bonnie’s Room
•  Toy Story 4 Characters
•  RC Redesign
•  Toy Mode (Works in ANDY CHAOS!)

Join our group for sneak peeks and play as Wheezy:
